title: No Colour Ink, So It Won't Print Black. Why?
topic: Inkjets use a little of every colour to clean and prime the print head, and some mix colours into 'black'; so an empty cyan can stop a black page.
audience: Everyday phone/PC/internet/game/AI-chat users who have seen this themselves
